items.caption: A pigeon can tell a Picasso from a Monet 🎨 Keio University, 1995: trained on slides, the birds also sorted paintings they had never seen. A Monet upside down confused them; a Picasso didn’t. Photos: Ben, E. Lazzaretti (iNaturalist, CC0). Monets: Art Institute of Chicago.
